mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.0 indicates strong supply chain activity and corporate capacity utilization, which supports earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index value above 220.0 indicates elevated inflation levels that prompt the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) above 560.0 indicates strong residential construction activity, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 560.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll level above 130000.0 (thousands of persons) signals a strong labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 130000.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicate robust economic expansion and supply chain resilience, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.
